# Sandcastle shovel asset provenance

Source: user-supplied Sandcastle Demo package, sharedassets0.assets.

- ShovelMedium_01 (path ID 551): 1,872 vertices, 2,816 triangles.
- ShovelMediumSandpile_01 (path ID 462): 56 vertices, 71 triangles.
- Original normals and red/cream vertex colours retained; coordinates converted to the lab blade-tip origin and length scaled to 1.72 local units.
- Embedded geometry: app/sandlab/sandcastle-shovel.json.
- Materials are rendered with Three.js; game shader binaries and runtime code are not embedded.
- Animation is implemented in the lab, not recovered from the game's source.

Game assets belong to their respective rights holders; this source note does not grant redistribution rights.
